Definition: mount of God; figuratively, the altar of burnt-offering
BiblicalUsage: Har'el means the mount of God, and it is the name for the altar hearth itself, the raised place where the offerings burned. In Ezekiel 43:15 the altar shall be four cubits, and from the altar upward shall be four horns, and the word marks the hearth as God's own mountain in miniature.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the altar was a mountain a man could approach, and the fire on it was the sign that God had come down to meet him there.
